items.body: VHIE uses opt-out consent: patients are included by default and can choose to exclude their data. Maximizes data completeness while preserving patient autonomy.
items.title: Vermont opt-out model

items.body: Legal frameworks governing how HIE data can be used by researchers, payers, and analytics platforms. Define permitted uses and prohibited disclosures.
items.title: Data use agreements

items.body: HIE Steering Committee, AHS leadership, VITL Board, and GMCB (for regulatory matters) shape Vermont's HIE governance landscape.
items.title: Governance bodies

items.body: Patients and providers must be able to understand what data is in the HIE, who has accessed it, and for what purpose. Audit trails are mandatory.
items.title: Transparency

content_blocks.body:
Just because data can be accessed doesn't mean it should be. Every data use decision in an HIE should be evaluated against three principles:

**Purpose limitation**: Is this use consistent with the purpose for which the data was originally collected? Patient data shared for treatment purposes should not be repurposed for commercial interests without explicit consent.

**Proportionality (minimum necessary)**: Are you using the minimum amount of data needed to accomplish the legitimate purpose? This mirrors HIPAA's minimum necessary standard.

**Benefit**: Does this use serve patients and the public? Who benefits, and who bears the risk?

These are not just legal questions — they are ethical ones, and every employee who touches data is a data steward.
content_blocks.heading: Ethics in data use decisions

content_blocks.body:
Patients can opt out of the VHIE at any time. An opt-out means:
• Their data will not appear in query results for authorized providers
• Their data will not be included in population analytics
• They can opt back in at any time
• Their care will not be affected by their opt-out decision

Approximately 3–5% of Vermont patients have opted out. Understanding the opt-out process is important for provider relations and patient-facing staff.
content_blocks.heading: Vermont's VHIE opt-out mechanics
